text:
Maya A.: Heads up 1: EU marketplace sent a credit memo for Partner channel that reversed recognized revenue for Feb. File: marketplace_credits_20260228.csv. Gross credit: 72,450. Our rev schedule already recognized these seats so revenue is overstated for Feb.
BillingBot: [automated] import_notice: marketplace_credits_20260228.csv 10 rows; 3 negative gross_amount rows flagged.
Priya K.: Can you confirm which GL lines were hit? Hosted revenue vs marketplace passthrough?
Maya A.: Quick lookup: 2 lines hit Hosted Revenue (4001), 1 line hit Marketplace Fee Rebate (4032). Net impact to revenue recognized: -72,450 (EUR).
Dana L.: Materiality check: 72.5k > our 50k manual-adjust threshold for EU close. Need approval to post manual reclassification/deferral and to restate Feb close if required.
Alex M.: Ops can re-import a corrected file if vendor provides a replacement. ETA from vendor?
Maya A.: Vendor says corrected CSV by EOD CET. But for month-end we can't wait. Proposal: post manual deferral today and reverse when cleaned import applied \u2014 include full audit memo.
Jon S.: What exact journal do you propose? We need specific debits/credits and FX handling.
Maya A.: Proposed journal (EUR):
```
DR Hosted Revenue (4001)    68,200
DR Marketplace Fee Rebate (4032)    4,250
CR Deferred Revenue (2100)    72,450
Memo: "Manual deferral for marketplace credit memo import; file marketplace_credits_20260228.csv; vendor corrected file pending."
```
Priya K.: For audit, include ticket id, spreadsheet with invoice ids/customer ids, copy of vendor email, and post-import logs once re-run. Also specify revaluation approach if we reverse in USD.
Dana L.: Approving the manual journal posting per policy, provided the packet includes: spreadsheet, ticket, vendor corrected file or email, ops import logs, and GL support. Post as of 2026-02-28 close with reversing entry when corrected import applied.
Alex M.: I'll schedule a dry-run re-import once vendor sends the file and attach the transform log + checksum. Ops will tag the ticket.
BillingBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-EU-177012 (title: EU marketplace credit memo 172.45k 1 manual deferral required)
Maya A.: Thanks  I've created the spreadsheet and cc'd Dana. Priya, Jon  can you review the spreadsheet now?
Priya K.: Reviewing now. I see the three invoice ids: PM-2026-0228-11, PM-2026-0228-12, PM-2026-0228-13. Totals match.
Jon S.: LGTM for numbers. I'll prepare the memo and attach vendor email thread.
Maya A.: Posting manual JE tomorrow morning after final sign-off. Will include "reversal when corrected import posted" and link to ticket FIN-EU-177012 in memo.
Dana L.: Thanks team. Flagging for month-end exceptions pack.
Maya A.: tagging @finance-ops and @eng-billing for visibility :white_check_mark:
